item.title: Ben Folds Slams Trump’s Kennedy Center Takeover Before Congress: ‘When You Politicize Art, You’ve Got Propaganda’
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and updates. Today, we're discussing a recent congressional forum that shed light on Donald Trump's various "vanity projects", including the overhaul of the Kennedy Center. Joining us to share his insights is singer-songwriter Ben Folds, who testified before lawmakers about the changes he witnessed as artistic advisor to the National Symphony Orchestra.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Ben Folds shared his experience of working at the Kennedy Center before and after Trump's takeover in February 2025. He described the center as a "hyper-politicized environment" where politics was never discussed before Trump's involvement.
[Audio clip of Ben Folds' testimony plays]
Ben Folds: "I never heard politics discussed in any meetings or gatherings at the center... Everyone involved, including the Trump board, knew we were there to create, educate and showcase art for all Americans, not to further a political agenda."
Host: Folds expressed his concerns about the politicization of art, stating that it can lead to propaganda. He also shared how Trump's actions affected the center's reputation and mission, making it difficult for artists to perform without being seen as endorsing or protesting the president's administration.
[Audio clip of Ben Folds' testimony continues]
Ben Folds: "I could not trust that the artists I booked to play at the Kennedy Center would be safe from retribution if they said or sung something that might displease the president or his political allies. For this reason, with great sadness, I had no choice but to resign."
Host: Folds also highlighted the investigation into Yasmin Levy's performance at the center, where she was booed by hecklers allegedly paid by Trump's interim executive director, Richard Grenell.
[Audio clip of Ben Folds' testimony concludes]
Ben Folds: "The takeover hobbled the Kennedy Center, broke its once-proven successful business model and disrespected its original core mission."
Host: The congressional forum aimed to bring attention to Trump's "vanity projects" that have wasted hundreds of millions of tax dollars. We'll continue to follow this story and provide updates as more information becomes available.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: Thank you for tuning in to our podcast. Join us next time for more in-depth discussions on the latest news and updates.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
